description: This file defines a CodecFactory for serialization and deserialization of Kubernetes API objects, supporting multiple formats (JSON, YAML, Protobuf) and versioning strategies.

classes.name: CodecFactory
classes.description: Provides methods for retrieving serializers and codecs for specific API versions and content types.

classes.name: CodecFactoryOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for CodecFactory behavior, such as strict mode, pretty printing, and serialization formats.

classes.name: WithoutConversionCodecFactory
classes.description: A wrapper for CodecFactory that disables conversion, used for external clients or migration.

methods.name: newSerializersForScheme
methods.description: Creates a list of serializers for different formats based on scheme and options.

methods.name: NewCodecFactory
methods.description: Constructs a new CodecFactory with specified options.

methods.name: newCodecFactory
methods.description: Helper for creating CodecFactory, used mainly for testing.

methods.name: WithoutConversion
methods.description: Returns a NegotiatedSerializer that performs no conversion.

methods.name: SupportedMediaTypes
methods.description: Returns supported media types for serialization.

methods.name: LegacyCodec
methods.description: Returns a codec for legacy encoding/decoding, deprecated in favor of CodecForVersions.

methods.name: UniversalDeserializer
methods.description: Returns a decoder capable of decoding any recognized data.

methods.name: UniversalDecoder
methods.description: Returns a decoder for all known API objects in all formats.

methods.name: CodecForVersions
methods.description: Creates a codec for specific encoder/decoder with versioning.

methods.name: DecoderToVersion
methods.description: Returns a decoder targeting a specific group version.

methods.name: EncoderForVersion
methods.description: Returns an encoder targeting a specific group version.
